meaning: The screen you see when you wake your phone. It keeps people out until you unlock it with a code, a fingerprint, or your face.
clues: It is a gate that stops other people from using your phone.
You see it before you open any app, often with the time and date shown big.
You get past it with a code, a fingerprint, or your face.
Missed calls and new messages can show on it, even while the rest of the phone stays shut.
It has two words. The first starts with L, and the second is what you look at.
assumes: A screen saver is a moving picture that shows when a screen sits idle
A wallpaper is the picture behind your app icons
The main screen of apps is where your app icons sit

decoys.meaning: A moving picture or pattern that shows on a screen after it has been idle for a while.
The picture that sits behind the icons on a phone or computer screen.
The main screen of a phone, where your app icons sit.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: I once got stuck behind a drawer lock and lost my own homework. A lock that keeps nosy people out? I approve.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Tip: set a code, or use your fingerprint or face. If you lose the phone, your photos and messages stay private.

sources.name: Android Help, Set screen lock on an Android device
